reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: Illuminating yet gentle, moisturizing and non-irritating, even on my sensitive skin. The lemon scent is so yummy! A recent fave!
reviews.zh: 提亮得嚟溫和，保濕又唔刺激，連我敏感肌都用得。檸檬味勁正！近期最愛！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: Nice morning serum with a very light citrus fragrance. Adds to the brightness of the skin, but not too much.
reviews.zh: 唔錯嘅朝早用精華，柑橘香味好淡。為皮膚增添光澤，不過唔算好明顯。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: This is good stuff. Nothing spectacular but definitely hydrates and has a brightening effect. Minimal though.
reviews.zh: 唔錯嘅嘢。唔算好特別，但肯定有保濕同提亮效果，不過好輕微。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: Lovely texture and easy to absorb

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: Love this serum!! Smells good, Texture is also good!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支精華！！味道好聞，質地都唔錯！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: It says it contains a lot of glutathione but I don't really see any impat yet. I will keep using it for longer
reviews.zh: 話佢含好多穀胱甘肽，但暫時未見到有咩明顯效果。我會繼續用耐啲先睇。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: I didn’t realize it had fragrance, I usually don’t buy products with it but it hasn’t been irritating and the scent is light
reviews.zh: 本身唔知呢款有香味，我通常唔會揀有香味嘅產品，但用咗之後又冇刺激，味道都算淡。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Brightening Serum 50ml Set (+Activator 3g)
reviews.text: this product isn't really advertised on the global oy website/app, but i happened to see a youtuber say it was good, so i bought it. i don't think it has too much of a dramatic effect, but it does make it feel like my face is clearer.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品其實喺全球 oy 網站／app 上面唔算有乜宣傳，但我偶然見到有 YouTuber 話好用，所以就買咗。我覺得佢效果唔算好戲劇性，不過用完的確覺得塊面清咗啲。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
